Tool call input: {'knowledge_bases': ['chemistry'], 'search_rounds_budget': 2, 'search_target': 'Determine the HOMO orbital energy in Hartree for the molecule represented by SELFIES [C][N][N][=C][Branch1][=Branch2][C][=Branch1][Ring2][=N][Ring1][Branch1][O][C][O]. Decode/validate the SELFIES, identify the exact structure, and use a quantum-chemical calculation or authoritative molecular property record; report the numeric HOMO energy and method/provenance.'}

The SELFIES decodes to **CN1N=C(C(=N1)OC)O**. The quantum-chemistry tool matched it to a QM9 InChIKey record and reports a HOMO energy of **−0.2052 Hartree**. The output does not specify the computational method beyond identifying the QM9 match.
